newsitem.title: USA: InterSystems Inc predicts profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: InterSystems Inc predicts profit in 1997.

text.p: InterSystems Inc said Wednesday that it has a "very profitable" start to its second quarter, reflecting a significant operating expansion and a record backlog of orders.
The company said net earnings in April were in excess of $100,000 versus a loss of more than $100,000 net loss in April 1996, while sales rose to $2.2 million last month from $1.2 million a year ago.
Barring any unforeseen economic circumstances, InterSystems said it anticipates major growth this year in revenues and earnings.
The company said the April results follow its return to profitability in the first quarter, after three years of operating losses.

It also said its plastics-compounding subsidiary, Chemtrusion Inc, is planning for at least a 25% expansion of its Houston plant to meet increasing demand, while InterSystems Nebraska operation, which specializes in the development of materials-handling systems, has a record backlog of nearly $5 million
In 1996 the company reported a loss of $2.3 million, or $0.38 a share, on revenues of $20.4 million.
